output_list.code: function setPrices(uint256 newSellPrice, uint256 newBuyPrice) onlyOwner public { sellPrice = newSellPrice; buyPrice = newBuyPrice; }
output_list.reason: The function setPrices allows anyone to change the buy and sell price. This could lead to the token being devalued. The onlyOwner modifier ensures that only the contract owner can call this function.
